description: CI regression gate for the default offline configuration (hashing embeddings, hybrid retrieval, no reranker). Calibrated on golden_v2 (9 documents) at hit_rate 0.947 / recall 0.941 / MRR 0.867 overall and hit_rate 0.957 on the test split; bounds leave room for about one additional miss. Raise them deliberately when retrieval improves.
